description: Generate a full ad script package for a product: 10 hooks, a scene-by-scene script, and model-native video prompts (Veo/Kling). Costs about 2-3 credits, metered and refunded in full if it fails. This CREATES an ad in the user's Promptify workspace and returns a link to it — it does not render video.

format.description: UGC testimonial | Unboxing | Problem → solution | Street interview | Before/after | Founder story

language.description: Language to write the ad in. Defaults to English.

productDescription.description: What it is and who it's for. The more concrete, the better the script.

templateId.description: Optional template id from list_templates — builds the ad on that hook device and beat structure.

name: generate_ad_script
title: Generate ad script (spends credits)
